description: This file defines a REST controller for managing Question entities, providing endpoints for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting questions, with integration to a QuestionRepository and handling of ResourceNotFoundExceptions.

classes.name: QuestionController
classes.description: REST controller providing CRUD operations for Question entities.

methods.name: getQuestions
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a paginated list of questions.

methods.name: createQuestion
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new question.

methods.name: updateQuestion
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing question identified by ID.

methods.name: deleteQuestion
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a question by ID.
